originalPrompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game VFX sprite atlas for a pet's battle-start support buff in a premium Korean fantasy card battler. Create ONE 2048x1024 transparent RGBA PNG sprite sheet with exactly 4 columns x 2 rows of 8 square animation frames in left-to-right then top-to-bottom order. All cells must have identical framing, same center at cell center, generous transparent padding, NO visible cell borders or background rectangles. Each is an isolated hand-painted 2D game effect, crisp symbolic core with elegant magical light, not a flat vector icon. Eight beats: 1 small ignition sparks; 2 rising arc and emerging symbol; 3 symbol forms; 4 clear strong full symbol with focused aura (this frame must also read as a small status icon); 5 aura pulse at peak; 6 fine outward motes; 7 energy settles; 8 very faint residual symbol and spark fade. The same identifiable central symbol stays geometrically consistent from frames 3 to 7. Keep glow localized, fully transparent outside the effect, no opaque backdrop, no white rectangles, no checkerboard texture. All light must fit inside each cell with at least 8% clear padding, never spilling into another cell. Camera straight on with shallow ellipse ground glimmer. Mature premium fantasy VFX, readable at small sizes, clean silhouette, restrained detail. Do not include characters, pets, UI panels, typography, numbers, labels, logos or watermarks.
Effect: ATTACK UP. Two immaculate straight short swords cross into a powerful upward-pointing crest, warm crimson and ember-orange steel light with bright pale-gold edges. Compact tongues of flame and two upward energy trails communicate power increased. Central crossed sword silhouette clearly reads in frame 4. Neither a projectile nor a damaging explosion; a positive support enhancement.

paddingEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this transparent game VFX sprite atlas ONLY to fix edge clipping and cell separation. Keep exactly the same 8 effects in the same order, the same colors, central motifs and 4 columns x 2 rows layout. Each effect currently fills its cell too much and some peak frame glow is cut off. Reconstruct any cut-off outer aura edges cleanly and make the COMPLETE effect in EVERY frame uniformly 25% smaller, centered within its individual square cell. Eight equal square cells, each must have at least 12% completely transparent padding on ALL FOUR SIDES even on the largest peak frame. There must be a clearly empty transparent gutter between every pair of neighboring cells and all around the sheet. No overlap or cell-to-cell glow bleed. Do not create a new motif, text, numbers, borders, background or additional frames. Keep 2:1 sheet aspect ratio, real RGBA alpha transparency with smooth edge fading; no opaque white, black or checkerboard background. Preserve the crisp full core emblem in frame 4 for use as an icon.
exportPolicy: Keep source PNG bytes unchanged; deterministic resize, atlas packing, frame crop and WebP export only.
